Side view colors forearms, legs and shoes but leaves the hair and upper back largely clay. Reject as incomplete colorization.

decision: Prepare a complete color prior from the existing coarse model's UV texture on the unchanged Direct3D surface, then test Qwen refinement.
limitations: Silhouette mask IoU cannot certify internal feature alignment.
